1	import { daysBetween } from './dates.js';
2	import { balanceDue } from './payments.js';
3	
4	/**
5	 * Get invoices that are overdue.
6	 * @param {Array} invoices
7	 * @param {string} asOf - date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array} array of { number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due }, sorted most overdue first
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  const overdue = invoices
12	    .filter(
13	      (invoice) =>
14	        (invoice.status === 'issued' || invoice.status === 'partially_paid') &&
15	        daysBetween(invoice.dueDate, asOf) > 0
16	    )
17	    .map((invoice) => ({
18	      number: invoice.number,
19	      customerId: invoice.customerId,
20	      dueDate: invoice.dueDate,
21	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(invoice.dueDate, asOf),
22	      due: balanceDue(invoice),
23	    }))
24	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
25	
26	  return overdue;
27	}
